title: buildzr workspace branding (buildzr.branding/1)
description: data/branding.<h8>.json: the images the scenes draw (icons) and the workspace's branding (logo, diagram font). Written only when there is one of them; index.json 'branding' points at it. Images are data URIs, so the file works offline and wherever the viewer is handed its data as JSON (embed mode).

id.description: sha256 of the image's data URI.

images.description: Image id -> data URI (base64) of a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG image.

name.description: branding.font.name as the workspace gives it.

family.description: The CSS font-family list the viewer sets the diagram text in; ends in Inter, sans-serif unless the name ends in a generic family.
